subject: Pilot readiness: recommended models, perf snapshot, and next steps
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot readiness: recommended models, perf snapshot, and next steps

Hi Sam — great to meet you and Nico on the call earlier. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we can scope a 2-week pilot: 

Recap (from today)
- Goal: integrate short-form content generation + reranking into Clearpath editor with <200ms p50 for interactive sessions and p95 <= 450ms in target region.
- Workload: avg prompt 300 tokens, typical batch = single-user interactive; occasional bulk rerank jobs (25–50 documents).
- Success metrics: relevance A/B vs baseline, latency SLOs, and cost per 1M tokens.

Redwood recommended models for pilot (quick shortlist):
- rwd/alphax-7b-instruct (Redwood-verified profile) — best balance of quality/latency for 300-token prompts.
- rwd/alpha-lite-3b-q4 — lower cost option for scale; expect slightly lower generation richness.
- open/llama3-13b-q4f32 (compat) — higher-quality fallback if you need fewer truncations.

Perf snapshot we’ll share: Redwood-verified performance profiles (per-model TPS, p50/p95 latency percentiles, memory footprint, and quantization notes). I attached the inference-profile-pack.pdf and a short prompt-set (prompt-set-v1.json) with the prompts we discussed. The Drive/S3 links below have full benchmark runs.

Immediate next steps
1) Can you confirm preferred pilot start window (week of Oct 26 or Nov 9)?
2) Nico: please confirm the single IP range we should allow for the VPC connector and whether you prefer hosted or dedicated for the pilot.
3) We’ll provision a small Redwood Dedicated pool (1x A100-equivalent) and run the supplied prompt-set; expected warm TPS and latency baseline in 48 hours after provisioning.

Attachments: inference-profile-pack.pdf (playbook + verified profiles), prompt-set-v1.json (sample prompts). Related links: https://drive.redwood.com/clearpath/pilot/inference-profile-pack

Thanks — I’ll loop Karthik for any model/quantization questions.

Best,
Olga

Sam — quick answers and links below, copying Karthik for the quantitative numbers.

1) p95 context: our p95 baseline numbers in the Redwood-verified profiles are measured under realistic concurrent load profiles (we include 1, 10, and 40-concurrency curves). The p95 <= 450ms figure is achievable for rwd/alphax-7b-instruct on a single A100-equivalent for interactive 300-token prompts at ~20 concurrent sessions with batching enabled and prefix KV caching. At 40 concurrent sessions you should see increased p95 (we provide curves in the perf pack) but can keep p95 <= 450ms by:
   - enabling small batching (2–4)
   - using our KV-prefix caching for repeated prompts
   - picking rwd/alphax-7b-instruct vs the 13b fallback

2) q4 quantization quality: short answer — minimal impact for most instruction-style prompts, but there are edge-cases (long context with rare tokens) where small degradation shows up on exact-match metrics. We include prompt-specific regression checks in the pack and a per-prompt delta vs baseline. Karthik: can you confirm the delta numbers for their prompt-set and outline recommended guardrails?

Links: full benchmark HTML summary: https://s3.redwood-inference.com/benchmarks/clearpath/20261012/results-summary.html
Drive pack: https://drive.redwood.com/clearpath/pilot/inference-profile-pack

If that looks good, we’ll pencil Oct 26 and start provisioning.

Best,
Olga

Hi all — Karthik here from the runtime team. Short technical notes and numbers from the trial runs against your prompt-set: 

Summary of measured numbers (attached CSV + included in S3 HTML):
- Model: rwd/alphax-7b-instruct (q4f32) on 1x A100-equivalent
  - p50 latency (300-token prompts, interactive): 118 ms
  - p95 latency (20 concurrent, batching 2): 392 ms
  - steady TPS (gen + decode): ~26 tokens/sec per GPU in this config
- Model: rwd/alpha-lite-3b-q4
  - p50: 82 ms 
  - p95 (20 concurrent): 520 ms (higher variance on longer outputs)
- Model: open/llama3-13b-q4f32
  - p50: 210 ms
  - p95 (20 concurrent): 590 ms

Quality delta vs unquantized baseline (per-prompt averages):
- alphax-7b-instruct q4f32: average BLEU/ROUGE-type delta ~ -0.8% on the sample set; named-entity hallucination rate unchanged in our checks
- alpha-lite-3b-q4: delta ~ -2.6%; caution for long-tail product names

Recommendations for Clearpath pilot configuration:
- Default: rwd/alphax-7b-instruct (q4f32) with batching 2 and KV-prefix cache enabled. This meets p95 <= 450ms at ~20 concurrent with margin.
- If you need lower cost: alpha-lite-3b-q4 for background reranking jobs; reserve alphax for interactive.
- Instrument: include our prompt regression set as automated evals during pilot to detect quality drift.
- Fallbacks: configure a model-fallback route to 13b variant when generation exceeds token budget or when eval confidence is low.

I attached throughput-snapshot-20261012.csv with raw numbers and the S3 link includes full traces. Happy to jump on a quick technical call with Nico to finalize VPC connector IPs and any firewall needs.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Staff Software Engineer, Runtime | Redwood Inference
